text: good that worked. now if i go low gravity and then jump under a floor, i end up glitching through it, which shouldnt happen

events.text: Root cause: the native physics engine already has a vertical head-bonk resolver, but ceilingUndersideAt rejects rows whose blocksPlayer flag is false. Live editor floor slabs intentionally use blocksPlayer=false so they are walkable platforms without side-push; low gravity merely lets the jump reach an upper floor, where the ceiling resolver then ignores its finite underside and the capsule passes through.

Verification: all four head-bonk tests pass, including the exact low-gravity/non-solid live-floor reproduction and a rotated-floor case; all ten camera tests remain green; ReleaseFast editor build succeeds. Full game-physics suite is 52/53 with the same unrelated hollow-ramp ascent failure seen before this task. The 02:00 repository checkpoint committed these two files as 9dc325627 while verification was running.

resolution: Fixed low-gravity jumping through upper-storey floors in the native Zig physics system. The ceiling resolver now treats every finite collider underside as physical even when a walkable slab disables horizontal side-push; unbounded ground and wall sentinels remain excluded. Added exact low-gravity and rotated-floor regression tests, retained the previous camera behavior, and rebuilt the ReleaseFast editor successfully.
